dedupe_keys.name: wufi transient heat and moisture simulation of building components and buildings

description: WUFI, short for Wärme Und Feuchte Instationär (transient heat and moisture), is a family of Fraunhofer IBP programs that calculate coupled one- and two-dimensional heat and moisture transport in walls and other multilayer components exposed to natural weather, and in whole buildings. Products include WUFI Pro, WUFI 2D, WUFI Plus, WUFI Passive and a free version, with add-ons; the software is validated against laboratory measurements and IBP's outdoor test field. News on the German site reports WUFI Pro 7.2 in March 2026, free for version 7 users, steep roof shading models in version 7.2.2.0 in April 2026, a revised guideline on condensate run-off risk in February 2026, and a WUFI Decay post-processor for timber and natural-fibre decay risk in August 2026. Coverage: generic, any climate with suitable data. Access: purchased licences, a price list and a free version. Licence: commercial. Caveats: results depend on material data and boundary conditions. Simulation uses: moisture and decay risk of retrofits and envelopes under present and future climates. Related records: THERM and WINDOW, and the timber-framed wall hygrothermal measurements.
